prompt:

Spec path: {{spec_path}}
Plugin name: {{plugin_name}}
Tech stack: {{tech_stack}}

Your task:

2. Extract: feature title, description, DONE-WHEN criteria, dependencies, architecture notes

5. Extract open questions and risks
6. Determine if this is a Node.js plugin, Python package, or other type

  "hooks": [{"name": "", "trigger": "", "description": ""}],
  "cli_commands": [{"name": "", "args": "", "description": ""}],
  "apis": [{"endpoint": "", "method": "", "description": ""}],
  "dependencies": [],
  "open_questions": [],
  "risks": [],
  "plugin_type": "node-plugin|python-package|standalone"
}
